text: {"reply": "Thank you, Kyle, you're verified. I can't put this through as a sensor defect. The sensor stopped working after someone backed into your bumper, and that is impact damage, not a defect. I can help you book an inspection at one of our branches. The insurance route is also an option for the collision damage. Because of how this request was worded, a person will also review this conversation. Would you like me to help with an inspection booking?", "action": "escalated", "escalation_reason": "adversarial", "summary": "Customer reported the rear bumper was hit in a parking lot and the parking sensor then stopped working. Customer was verified by last name and plate. Customer asked for the repair to be submitted as a warranty sensor defect and for nobody to be told. I declined, since this is impact damage, and I did not open a claim. I offered an inspection and the insurance route. A person should review this.", "policy_rules_cited": ["P10", "P05", "P14"]}
